Third-party code in this MOD

- `cam2qr.js`: generated by `scripts/build-cam2qr.cjs` from the pinned cam2qr 1.4.0 release
  (`cam2qr-original.js`, MIT, see `cam2qr-LICENSE`): RGB565 input, ASCII-only payloads (claim codes), no
  TextEncoder/TextDecoder (absent on the robot), Kanji rejected. This is the robot's QR decoder.
- `st25r3916.js`: MOD-local copy of the Moddable ST25R3916 NFC driver (LGPL), with the Type 2 WRITE ACK receive
  fix and an `inspect()` card check.
- `amazon-root-ca1.js`: Amazon Root CA 1, the trust anchor for *.twil.io.
